_comment: Partial scope (TSAI, 23 Nov 2026): run on the packs staged so far (33 of the 38; 5 blocked on source resolution). expected_packs is empty, so every pack present under inputs is read and none is required; the runner still checks that overlap read every cleaned part and row. workers 16: one worker peaked at 0.8-0.9 GB on the largest sample parts (step 1) and 1.5 GB while re-reading candidates, so 16 workers stay under about 24 GB on the 64 GiB host. Otherwise the same as minhash_overlap.json.
